create_byte_bpe_encoder: create a ByteBPE encoder instance using a SentencePiece model path from config
encode_text_with_byte_bpe: encode a string into byte-level BPE tokens using the ByteBPE encode method
decode_byte_bpe_tokens: decode byte-level BPE tokens back to the original string using the static decode method
configure_byte_bpe_model_path: configure the ByteBpeConfig dataclass with a sentencepiece model path for BPE encoding
register_byte_bpe_encoder: register the ByteBPE class as a BPE encoder with the name byte_bpe using the decorator
